files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- **Play trailer**: movie and TV show pages link to the trailer on YouTube (or Vimeo),
  in your TMDB language if there is one, else in English. The link is hidden when TMDB
  has no trailer. (#107)
- **Where to watch**: movie and TV show pages list the streaming services that offer the
  title in your country, with their logos, and link to the title's page on TMDB. The
  country comes from your TMDB language in Settings (for example `de-DE` is Germany, `en-US`
  the United States); the page names it. The data comes from JustWatch via TMDB. TMDB gives no direct links
  into the services. Trailer and offers are fetched when you open a page and kept on
  the server for 12 hours, so they need a TMDB key but no refresh and no migration. (#107)
- **Network logos** on the TV show page instead of the network names. (#107)

### Changed
- The TV show page says **"Last synced with TMDB"** at the bottom of the page instead of
  "Episodes last updated from TMDB" under the details, because the sync also updates type,
  network, score and cast. (#107)
- **New app icon**: three colourful rings with a play button, in the style of the
  Nextcloud logo (used with the kind permission of Nextcloud GmbH). The navigation
  icon is a monochrome version of the same shape; the README shows the colour logo.
- **Requires PHP 8.3 or later.** Nextcloud 33 and 34 already mark PHP 8.2 as deprecated,
  and Nextcloud 35 no longer supports it. The App Store now offers MovieDB only to
  servers with PHP 8.3 or later.
